rerolls.note: Cannot re-roll the same die twice.

exploration_skills.name: Duplicate
exploration_skills.effect: After rolling, select one die and add an extra die with an identical result.

exploration_skills.name: Re-roll
exploration_skills.effect: Re-roll up to 1 extra Exploration Die.

exploration_skills.name: Set Dice
exploration_skills.effect: After rolling, select one die and change its result to any value (1-6).

exploration_skills.name: Seek
exploration_skills.effect: Add 1 to your Exploration Roll total.

exploration_skills.name: Circle Back
exploration_skills.effect: Subtract 1 from your Exploration Roll total.

exploration_skills.name: Lucky
exploration_skills.effect: After rolling, select one die, then roll an extra die. Keep the original or replace it with the new one.

common.name: Moonshine Stash
common.description: You find a hidden stash of strong distilled alcohol, its origin uncertain and unsafe.

options.name: Distribute
options.effect: +2 DICE to Morale Checks in your next game.

options.name: Destroy
options.effect: Up to two ELITE models earn +1 XP each. If entitled to Advancement Roll, make it immediately.

options.name: Sell
options.effect: Add 30 ducats to Strongbox.

common.name: Heavy Weapons Cache
common.description: You find a hidden weapons cache.

options.name: Surplus
options.effect: Choose one piece of Battlekit with the HEAVY Keyword from your Armoury Tables and add it to Arsenal.

options.name: Specialise
options.effect: Choose one Glory Item with Cost up to 5 glory, add to Arsenal.

common.name: Trench Shrine
common.description: You find a crude shrine erected by the soldiers of the Great War.

options.name: Standard
options.effect: Add a Troop Flag to Arsenal.

options.name: Shrine
options.effect: Add a Field Shrine to Arsenal.

options.name: Return
options.effect: Your Warband gains +2 glory.

common.name: Ruined House
common.description: This house has been obliterated by heavy weaponry, its inhabitants ripped apart.

options.name: Rummage
options.effect: Choose Equipment from Armoury Tables worth up to 30 ducats total, add to Arsenal.

options.name: Relic
options.effect: Choose one Glory Item worth up to 7 glory, add to Arsenal.

common.name: Survivor
common.description: You find a soldier staggering in No Man's Land. Add the model listed below for your Faction to your Warband (no Battlekit).

options.name: New Antioch
options.effect: Add a Yeoman without Ranged Weapon.

options.name: Trench Pilgrims
options.effect: Add an Ecclesiastical Prisoner.

options.name: Iron Sultanate
options.effect: Add an Azeb.

options.name: Heretic Legions
options.effect: Add a Wretched.

options.name: Black Grail
options.effect: Add a Grail Thrall.

options.name: The Court
options.effect: Add a Wretched.

common.name: Fallen Soldier
common.description: You find the body of a fallen soldier.

options.name: Loot
options.effect: Choose one Ranged Weapon from Armoury Tables worth up to 15 ducats, add to Arsenal along with Combat Helmet and Standard Armour. Roll D6: on 4+, add a Medi-kit, Mountaineer's Kit, or Shovel.

common.name: Trench Merchant
common.description: You establish contact with a Trench Merchant.

options.name: Report
options.effect: Your Warband gains +2 glory.

options.name: Trade
options.effect: From now on, in the Quartermaster Step, you can purchase Glory Items costing 5 glory or less.

common.name: Map & Document Bag
common.description: Marked with carefully concealed signs, you find a hidden satchel containing maps and intelligence.

options.name: Gain Skill
options.effect: Your Warband gains the Re-roll Exploration Skill.

common.name: Sniper's Lair
common.description: You find the well-camouflaged position of a sniper. Add the Battlekit listed for your Faction to Arsenal. If not allowed, add Cost in ducats to Strongbox instead.

options.name: New Antioch / Trench Pilgrims
options.effect: Sniper Rifle or Sniper Scope.

options.name: Iron Sultanate
options.effect: Siege Jezzail, Alchemical Ammunition, and Cloak of Alamut.

options.name: Heretic Legions
options.effect: Automatic Rifle.

options.name: Black Grail
options.effect: Corruption Belcher and Field Shrine.

options.name: The Court
options.effect: Ophidian Rifle.

common.name: Fallen Knight
common.description: You find a fallen hero of past ages. Perhaps a baron from New Antioch, a great Faris of the Sultanate, or a Plague Knight of Beelzebub.

options.name: Loot
options.effect: Add Reinforced Armour, Trench Shield, Combat Helmet, and either a Sword or Polearm to Arsenal.

options.name: Memorialise
options.effect: Your Warband gains +2 glory.

common.name: Warband Strongbox
common.description: You find the hidden strongbox of a Warband lost in the Great War.

options.name: Trove
options.effect: Choose Battlekit from Armoury Tables worth up to 120 ducats total, add to Arsenal.

options.name: Panoply
options.effect: Choose Glory Items worth up to 9 glory total. Weapons cost -1 glory (min 1).

rare.name: Angelic Instrument
rare.description: You discover an otherworldly instrument alongside the shattered remains of a lesser angel.

options.name: Take
options.effect: Add an Angelic Instrument to Arsenal. Counts as Musical Instrument with 8" range instead of 4". Can replace existing Musical Instrument (no refund).

rare.name: Abandoned Prophetic Radio Post
rare.description: You find a hastily-abandoned Synod of Strategic Prophecy station, with scribbled predictions and prophecies.

options.name: Gain Skill
options.effect: Your Warband gains the Extra Dice Exploration Skill.

rare.name: Pot of Manna
rare.description: You find a cup blessed by God that provides endless nourishment.

options.name: Take
options.effect: Add 10 ducats to the loot you receive each Exploration Step permanently (including this one).

rare.name: Ransacked Alchemist Workshop
rare.description: Amidst the rubble, you find a few intact life-giving potions.

options.name: Take
options.effect: Add Curative Fluids to Arsenal. Once in any future Quartermaster Step, remove 1 Battle Scar (not Trauma effects) from a model. Single use.

rare.name: Black Market
rare.description: You discover a major underground trading post in No Man's Land.

options.name: Establish Contact
options.effect: From now on, in Quartermaster Step, you can purchase Glory Items costing 8 glory or less.

rare.name: Book of Golems
rare.description: You find a Rabbinic manual on creating Golems.

options.name: Create Golem
options.effect: Add a Takwin Homunculus (from House of Wisdom) to Warband with Human Hands + up to 50 ducats of Alchemical Formulas free. Gains GOLEM Keyword, replaces SULTANATE with your Faction Keyword. Treated as Ally, cannot be Promoted.

rare.name: Ruined Church/Masjid/Synagogue
rare.description: You find a great shrine, temple or other religious building of faith. Upon its altar rests an object of great power.

options.name: Report
options.effect: Your Warband gains +4 glory.

options.name: Keep
options.effect: Choose one Glory Item worth up to 10 glory, add to Arsenal.

rare.name: Stash of Drugs & Erotica
rare.description: You find a motherlode of forbidden objects and chemicals, highly sought after and in demand.

options.name: Indulge
options.effect: +1 DICE to Morale Checks for the rest of the campaign.

options.name: Sell
options.effect: Your Warband gains 120 ducats.

options.name: Confiscate
options.effect: Your Warband gains +4 glory. Trench Pilgrims must select this option.

rare.name: Saint's Reliquary
rare.description: You discover the well-hidden reliquary of a fallen saint.

options.name: Take
options.effect: Add Saintly Relic to Arsenal (Equipment for ELITE models). Model gains TOUGH, loses INFILTRATOR. Opponent ignores Cover and Defended Obstacle modifiers vs this model.

rare.name: High-Ranking Captive
rare.description: You capture a high-ranking enemy — an officer, sheik, shard, prophet, merchant, or other important personage.

options.name: Ransom
options.effect: Your Warband gains 100 ducats.

options.name: Execute
options.effect: Your Warband gains +4 glory.

options.name: Imprison
options.effect: Choose one Glory Item with Cost up to 8 glory, add to Arsenal.

options.name: Indenture
options.effect: Your Warband gains the Set Dice Exploration Skill.

rare.name: Abandoned Resurrection Machines
rare.description: You find remnants of machines from the Meta-Christ Programme. One of them works and can be dismantled.

options.name: Take
options.effect: Add Salvaged Resurrection Machine to Arsenal. In any future Quartermaster Step, remove 1 Battle Scar and its Trauma from a model. Single use.

legendary.name: Battlefield of Corpses
legendary.description: You come across a scene of terrible slaughter. Remains of humans and Hellish creatures from 800 years of battles.

options.name: Loot
options.effect: Choose up to 2 pieces of Battlekit from Armoury Tables worth up to 100 ducats total, add to Arsenal.

legendary.name: Esoteric Library
legendary.description: You find a concealed collection of works on Goetic Magic, blood sacrifice rites, and grimoires on demon summoning.

options.name: Burn
options.effect: Your Warband gains 3+D3 glory.

options.name: Release Plague
options.effect: At the start of each game, after deployment, place 1 INFECTION MARKER next to 1 model (friend or foe).

options.name: Sell
options.effect: Your Warband gains 6D6 × 10 ducats.

options.name: Study
options.effect: At the start of each game, after deployment, place 1 BLOOD MARKER next to 1 model (friend or foe).

legendary.name: Hidden Passages
legendary.description: You uncover a hidden entrance to a vast underground network, perhaps dug by Heretics to infiltrate the Iron Wall.

options.name: Gain Skill
options.effect: Your Warband gains the Duplicate Exploration Skill.

legendary.name: Jabirean Alchemical Book
legendary.description: You find one of the fabled books of the Jabirean Corpus, filled with wondrous secrets.

options.name: Keep
options.effect: From now on, in Quartermaster Step, you can purchase Fire Shields from the House of Wisdom Armoury Tables.

options.name: Sell
options.effect: Your Warband gains 150 ducats or 5 glory (choose one).

options.name: Study
options.effect: Alchemical Formulae now cost 5 ducats less (minimum 5 ducats).

legendary.name: Black Network Contact
legendary.description: You make contact with one of the legendary Merchant Princes of the Black Network.

options.name: Establish Contact
options.effect: From now on, in Quartermaster Step, you can purchase Glory Items costing 12 glory or less.

legendary.name: Treasure of the Holies
legendary.description: You find a legendary feretory — the Tabernacle, an altar to the Morning Star, a shrine of Saint Peter, or a place the Prophet visited.

options.name: Take
options.effect: Score D3 Campaign Victory Points. Add one Glory Item to Arsenal for free (can defer choice to any future Quartermaster Step).

legendary.name: Skull of a Saint
legendary.description: You find the skull of a saint martyred in ages past. The power of communion lingers in its holy remains.

options.name: Faithful Relic
options.effect: Add Skull Relic to Arsenal (HELD Equipment, any model). Model gains INFILTRATOR Keyword.

options.name: Heretic Trophy
options.effect: Add Screaming Skull to Arsenal (HELD Equipment, any model). +2 DICE to Morale Checks while bearer is on battlefield and not Down/OOA. Gain +1 glory at end of any game where bearer is on battlefield and not Down/OOA.

legendary.name: Lock of Samson's Hair
legendary.description: You discover a lock of the legendary Samson's hair, imbued with the essence of the strongest warrior to ever live.

options.name: Take
options.effect: Add Lock of Samson's Hair to Arsenal (Equipment, any model). Model gains STRONG Keyword and +1 INJURY DICE to Melee Attacks.

legendary.name: Patron's Visit
legendary.description: Your Patron or their representative makes a surprise visit to your Warband.

options.name: Exchange
options.effect: Immediately exchange up to 10 glory for an equal number of Campaign Victory Points.

legendary.name: Sample of Holy DNA
legendary.description: You find a sample of Holy DNA.

options.name: Treat Model
options.effect: Pick 1 model — treated with Holy DNA. When Activated, before Actions, can remove 1 BLOOD or INFECTION MARKER and replace with BLESSING MARKER.

legendary.name: Golgotha Tektites
legendary.description: Golgotha Tektites are used to forge the armour of the mighty Paladins.

options.name: Treat Armour
options.effect: Pick up to 2 suits of Armour. They gain NEGATE FIRE, NEGATE GAS, and NEGATE SHRAPNEL Keywords.

options.name: Donate to Church
options.effect: Hand over to the Church: gain +15 glory.

legendary.name: Fruit from the Tree of Good and Evil Knowledge
legendary.description: Amongst the bones of giant humans unearthed by war you discover a golden-hued fruit wrapped in spun cloth.

options.name: Consume
options.effect: Pick 1 model — gains DEMONIC Keyword and one Skill of your choice from any Skill Table, Patron Skill, or Exploration Skill.
